Kingdom Two Crowns: Pharaoh Lands | DLC Announcement Trailer
Pharaoh Lands is a DLC for the side-scrolling micro strategy game, Kingdom Two Crowns. Adventure within the Valley of Kings and discover the domain of powerful gods in an ancient Egypt-inspired setting as you uncover the source of the chaos throughout the land.  

Beneath a scorching sun, a vista of rolling dunes and massive pyramid monuments rising towards the sky reveals itself. In Kingdom Two Crowns: Pharaoh Lands, you are setting out on a new adventure in the Valley of Kings and the domain of powerful gods in an ancient Egypt-inspired setting, only to discover the Greed now stalks the nights unleashed by foreboding chaos.

Bad Magpie | XBOX on PC Demo Trailer
Bad Magpie's demo drops you into a corner of one of the three areas in the game's chaotic and colourful world, along with your first glimpse of the story behind the magpie's obsessive quest for shiny trinkets. 

Your goal is to collect meteorite shards scattered across the map. Only the truly obsessive find them all.

Play the Bad Magpie demo on XBOX on PC now. Full game coming 2027 day one with XBOX Game Pass on XBOX Series X|S and XBOX on PC.

text:
Mafia III - XBOX Series X|S Launch Trailer
Family isn’t who you’re born with, it's who you die for.

Mafia III is now available natively on XBOX Series X|S, free for existing Mafia III & Mafia: The Omertà Collection owners.

To celebrate 10 years since Mafia III made its debut, we're honoring a decade of Lincoln Clay's legacy with a new update bringing quality-of-life enhancements to Mafia III, live now. In addition, Mafia III is now available on XBOX Series X|S with 60 FPS gameplay and technical improvements.

Mafia: The Omertà Collection includes:
• Mafia: The Old Country Definitive Edition, including the Man of Honor expansion and Deluxe content
• Mafia: Definitive Edition
• Mafia II: Definitive Edition, including all DLC
• Mafia III: Definitive Edition
